versions.content: Simultaneous Rate Correction measurements shall be started with a defined offset (to n ) to yield Rate Corrections evenly distributed over the measurement duration. to n = n * ( StbMRateCorrectionMeasurementDuration / St bMRateCorrectionsPerMeasurementDuration ) (where ‘n’ is the zero - based index of the current measurement) .
